nepaliNameRoman: Syau ko Sukuti / Sukeko Syau (Himalayan Apple Rings)
shelfLife: 9–12 months in a tightly sealed pouch
whatItIs: NaturesMud Dehydrated Apple (traditionally loved in Nepal as Syau ko Sukuti / स्याउको सुकुटी) is made from crisp, high-altitude apples grown in the cold mountain orchards of Mustang and Jumla. Cored and sliced into thin rings with their pectin-rich skin intact, they are gently dehydrated in hygienic closed chambers with 0% added sugar and 0% sulphur bleaching.
nepaliKitchenUses: Classic Himalayan Trail & Desk Snack: Munch crisp-chewy apple rings straight from the pouch during office hours, road trips, or treks.
Warm Cinnamon Apple Oats / Dalia: Simmer 3–4 chopped apple rings with rolled oats, milk, a pinch of cinnamon, and Dates Powder for a cozy breakfast.
Spiced Apple Kahwa / Herbal Tea: Steep 2 apple rings with a small piece of cinnamon and ginger in hot water for a soothing mountain apple tea.
Toddler Finger Food & Tiffin: Pack in school tiffin boxes as a clean, mess-free fruit snack instead of packaged biscuits.
whoItSuits: Ideal for school children, office professionals, trekkers, elders, and anyone wanting authentic Mustang/Jumla apple nutrition year-round.
monsoonStorage: Keep the ziplock pouch tightly sealed after opening so the apple rings do not absorb ambient monsoon humidity. Store in a cool, dry cupboard.

faqs.q: What is the price of Dehydrated Apple (स्याउको सुकुटी) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Dehydrated Apple (100 GM Pouch) costs Rs. 510 in Nepal (Rs. 510 per 100g). About 900g–1kg of fresh Himalayan apples are dehydrated to make one 100 GM pouch.

faqs.q: Where are the apples sourced from?
faqs.a: We source crisp mountain apples from high-altitude orchards in Mustang and Jumla, where cold nights and bright alpine sun create dense natural sweetness.

faqs.q: Why is the apple skin left on the rings?
faqs.a: Apple skin contains a high concentration of natural pectin (soluble dietary fiber) and polyphenols, so we wash the apples thoroughly and slice them skin-on.

faqs.q: Are these apple rings fried like chips or air-dehydrated?
faqs.a: They are 100% air-dehydrated at low temperature with zero oil, zero frying, and zero added sugar.

faqs.q: How can I soften Dehydrated Apple rings for younger kids or elders?
faqs.a: Soak the rings in warm water, warm milk, or simmering oatmeal for 5 minutes until tender and plump.
